criterion: The NAT-020 loader, started from the RECOVERY slot with visible stage markers, reaches its memory preparation, ADT/boot_args and pre-jump stages on the S24 (CRC-valid STAGE frames MAIN, FB, MEM, ZERO, COPY, ADT, CLEAN, PRE_JUMP decoded from an independent recording). The image holds at PRE_JUMP and never branches to the kernel copy: this is not XNU entry.
summary: One native run of NAT-022 loader-diag-trig-hold-adt8-aln (RECOVERY image sha256 cdf4f3a15831fb7c6c488085da33c12ade231460323583fd4090114945b285cd, Image.payload 2fb3968787688f4feb5b1dc09e4622309f1e22e5e8d76c82178d8716f1642da9, loader Image f0e61342dabb231098b71a13eb023a47d068adcec39fca1dc4b86e8d868f4cb7, source commit c5b942a, decision commit ccd5c22). It was written to RECOVERY (/dev/block/sda18) with a matching full readback and booted once (adb reboot recovery at 2026-11-10T16:23:31.6Z). The owner filmed the screen (85.8 s recording, 720x1280) and then, in their own words, put the phone into Download Mode without waiting for it to reboot. decode_video.py (--y0 10, four windows) decoded 754 CRC-valid frames (STAGE 333, REG 344, BOOTID 77). The decoded sequence is STAGE 0x20 MAIN (0.0-2.3 s), 0x21 FB, 0x30 MEM (4.0-12.3 s, includes the RAM zeroing), 0x31 ZERO, 0x32 COPY, 0x33 ADT, 0x34 CLEAN, then 0x40 PRE_JUMP (from 18.8 s), after which a hold loop repeats every ~18.65 s: STAGE 0x40, STAGE idx1 reached-stage mask 0x01ff (ENTRY, MAIN, FB, MEM, ZERO, COPY, ADT, CLEAN, PRE_JUMP; no FAIL bit), STAGE idx2 0x0000 (no failure code), BOOTID 0xb835/0x26af, STAGE 0x40, REG 0..9 (status 1 or 2 alternating, GLOBAL_CON 0x0133/0x0113, TRIG_CON 0x3062<->0x3063, kick count 0x0f, 0x1e, 0x2d). No EXC (0x1f), FAIL (0x3f), SLOT, ESR, ELR or FAR frame occurs among the 754 CRC-valid frames. The alignment fault of run 005 did not recur: the ADT patch, boot_args and cache-clean stages completed. The loader never branched to the kernel copy (mk_hold is noreturn and precedes the only return of the entry address); no XNU code ran. Stock RECOVERY was restored with one NAT-013 session in Download Mode (host observer saw 04e8:685d, bus 5 dev 58, at 16:25:25Z; restore 16:30:33Z-16:30:36Z; Android back at 16:31:31Z); the full hash equals stock 96620b8b..., check_android pass, assess pass, Android booted.

established: The NAT-020 loader, built from the pinned source with the NAT-022 instrumentation and the NAT-027 aligned ADT accesses, ran on the S24 from the RECOVERY slot through every stage up to the pre-jump hold: its own CRC-valid markers MAIN, FB, MEM, ZERO, COPY, ADT, CLEAN and PRE_JUMP were decoded from an independent recording, the held reached-stage mask is 0x01ff and no FAIL or exception frame appeared (goal step 4 up to, but excluding, the jump).
The NAT-027 fix removed the run-005 alignment fault: the ADT patch (MPIDR, DRAM, pram, ramdisk rebase), boot_args build and the full-window cache clean completed without an exception.
The image held at PRE_JUMP and never branched to the kernel copy; no XNU code ran, so nothing here is evidence of kernel entry.

Timing seen with the 1.2 s marker dwell included: window choice + zeroing ~8 s, copy of 21.5 MB ~1 s, ADT patch and clean each within about a second or two; the loader armed its 83 s watchdog (per source) and the display was still showing PRE_JUMP markers at 82.9 s.
Stock RECOVERY was restored by one NAT-013 session and Android booted with the stock hash and user data intact (check_android, assess).
not_established: That the patched ADT and boot_args contents are correct for XNU; only that the code that builds them ran to completion on the device.
Any jump into the kernel copy, any XNU entry or any marker inside XNU. Not attempted; not authorized by decision 0014.
That the full-window cache clean made the copied kernel visible to an instruction fetch after a jump (the clean marker and the pre-jump marker prove only that the code ran).
The exact RAM window chosen (implied only from run 005: window base about 0x9dd3fc000), and whether any firmware-owned memory lies in it.
What the loader would do after its 83 s watchdog (the owner put the phone into Download Mode; the recording ends at 85.8 s).
Stride and pixel format; whether the kick or S-Boot refresh makes the markers visible (no no-kick control).
REG block at 64.8-77.1 s: FRAME_COUNT idx7/idx8 both 0x0da0 and TRIG_CON-after not decoded; not interpreted.
